title: Tycoon Tex
build: Gremlin Graphics cassette, Novaload, from the TOSEC raw tape (2016-11-11)

tools.emulator: plus4emu 1.2.11 (git 939e652) with kit/c16/codemap.patch, built without libsndfile, in the kit's server
tools.browser: Chromium 141 through Playwright (node), for the page checks

accuracy.note: every routine ported and checked against the game's code, alone and in lockstep; no comment in the listing needed correcting

exclude: runtime: nothing of the game is loaded below $1000. Zero page, which start clears from $07 and the game uses for its variables; the stack; the KERNAL's vectors at $0314-$0315, which install_irq points at irq; Tex's characters saved at $0400 while he dies (tex_death); the menu's saved characters at $0560 (show_logo_chars); and the leftovers of the Novaload loader in pages 1 to 3

runtime: the screen, its colours at $0800 and characters at $0C00. At the hand-over they hold the Novaload loader's screen (TYCOON TEX and NOVALOAD A100000); start clears it through the KERNAL and the menu, the HUD and the play field are drawn by the game
extra: the 256-character set of the skyline and the pipeline, which TED reads from $1000 in irq_skyline and irq_pipe
